description: This Java source file defines the MacroCallMatcher class, which is a custom matcher used in testing. It matches RenderableFtl macro call objects by their name and parameters, providing detailed mismatch descriptions.

classes.name: MacroCallMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher that verifies if a RenderableFtl macro call has a specific name and parameters, used primarily in unit testing.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks if the given RenderableFtl item matches the specified macro name and parameters.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a description of the expected macro call, including its name and parameters.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Describes why a RenderableFtl macro call does not match the expected name or parameters.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher checking for a macro call with a specific name.

methods.name: hasParameters
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for macro calls with specific parameters.

methods.name: hasNameAndParameters
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for macro calls with a specific name and parameters.
